title: EngineCore 的逐拍循环（Part III 引擎的心跳：调度循环）

run.result: 48 passed in 13.94s (run 1) and 48 passed in 13.94s (run 2, stability re-run) — original gate; INDEPENDENTLY RE-GATED 2026-08-22 by a second tester pass: 48 passed in 13.94s and 48 passed in 13.94s again (total 4 consecutive full passes, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 xfail, 0 warnings). Suite = 41 in-process unit/contract tests + 7 end-to-end tests over real ZMQ (real mp-spawn engine subprocess born through launch_core_engines/CoreEngineProcManager, real ROUTER/PULL front-end, two-layer handshake, UTILITY thin-RPC scripting).

run.docker_rationale: No container run needed for this gate: the companion deliberately avoids the vllm package and any accelerator; every piece of third-party machinery it exercises (pyzmq, torch CPU, msgpack, mp spawn) is host-available and ran live. The pin's Linux-only surface it cannot reach on this host (real CUDA D2H copy stream, real msgspec, real xgrammar kernel, real model forward) is explicitly delegated to documented same-semantics seams (AsyncGPUModelRunnerOutput threading.Event D2H mirror, _msgspec_seam, _XgrammarSeam, scripted-forward-as-ch17-boundary), each marked inline and registered in impl-notes §Seam 清单; fidelity of the seam-adjacent control flow was verified directly against the pin source by anchor reads below (re-confirmed by the re-gate). A container re-run would add the real kernel/msgspec bytes but the pin container's vLLM is not the pinned v0.27.1 anyway, so host gate + pin-source anchor reads is the faithful combination.

verification.deviation_audit: Every impl-vs-pin difference seen at the anchors maps to a dossier subtraction_plan delete item (1 DP, 2 EEP/FT, 3 KV/EC connector, 4 tensor IPC/mm cache, 5 pause/sleep+idle callbacks, 6 UTILITY method bodies, 7 spec decode, 8 step_with_batch_queue, 9 observability, 10 runner deep-water, 11 scheduler deep-water stub, 12 core_client side) or a registered seam in impl-notes §Seam 清单. Known deviation 4 (client-initiated abort sends NO engine→client output in non-DP) re-confirmed against the pin by the re-gate: _send_abort_outputs appears only at core.py:L1484 (shutdown abort mode), L1866 (reject-add-in-shutdown), and L1550 is _handle_request_preproc_error→_send_abort_outputs_to_client (preproc error path) — never on the plain abort path; the e2e abort test asserts exactly this pin behavior (request vanishes from outputs, engine parks, double-abort idempotent). Known deviation 5 (sync step() is the teaching path while v0.27.1 serves with async_scheduling default-on) matches the dossier's mandated honesty note; the async executor path itself is still tested (AsyncOutputFuture D2H wait).
verification.cross_chapter_consistency: _msgspec_seam.py re-diffed by the re-gate against ch05's implementation copy (diff --strip-trailing-cr: identical) — same wire serialization as the chapter that owns the ZMQ physical layer. e2e tests speak the ch05 front-end protocol (byte-tag type frames, ROUTER bind with LAST_ENDPOINT writeback, PULL outputs, two-layer handshake) so the engine-side companion interoperates with the already-gated ch05 contract. Scheduler seam boundaries (schedule loop body → ch10, preemption → ch11, batch queue → ch12, forward → ch17, FSM compiler → ch30) are the same-signature stubs the dossier delete item 11 explicitly approves; ch10's companion already exists in the tree (tests passed there under its own gate).
verification.coverage: All 13 dossier mechanisms m1-m13 have ≥1 behavioral test (mapping in the test module header; dossier mechanisms list = 13 confirmed by re-gate): m1 five beats (ordering+timestamps+non_block spy+idle guard+zero-token skip+throttle passthrough), m2 busy loop (idle parking, single-pass mode, SystemExit), m3 two-phase contract (verbatim State error ×2 faces, stash/unpack/clear, ten-field NamedTuple shape, AsyncOutputFuture D2H semantics ×4 tests), m4 bitmask window (fast path, prefill-chunk exclusion + no partial-prefill output invariant, mask-beats-argmax on real tensors, ②→③→apply→④ timestamp window), m5 preprocess off-loop (grammar_init traced at preprocess, not on the loop), m6 output routing (in-process client bucketing + 2-front-end e2e with engine_index stamping), m7 abort dual channel (batch merge, idempotency, WAKEUP no-op, e2e mid-flight abort silence), m8 two-layer handshake e2e (HELLO→addresses→READY via real launcher; EngineCoreReadyResponse first message per data DEALER with post-init config), m9 shutdown/death (abort mode with client-routed abort outputs, drain mode keeps stepping, reject-add, EXECUTOR_FAILED raise, ENGINE_CORE_DEAD single frame + non-zero process exit), m10 InprocClient (docstring + direct step_fn drive to completion), m11 step_fn binding + structural hole, m12 update_from_output hot loop (append/judge-stop LENGTH+STOP with stop_reason, abort-skip, client bucketing), m13 token account (full-prefill→per-token decode, budget-capped chunks with real is_prefill_chunk semantics, mixed-phase {req_id: num_tokens} dict).
verification.conditional_trigger_discipline: Conditional-trigger tests assert the precondition before the effect, per contract: abort tests first establish the request is mid-flight (first token received) and the forward script is generously long (100 rows) before aborting, then assert silence (not just no-exception); drain-mode test first asserts unfinished work exists (max_tokens=100) before asserting the loop keeps stepping; prefill-chunk test first asserts budget 2 < prompt 3 and is_prefill_chunk True before asserting no manager call and no partial output.

notes: Windows host: python3 is the broken WindowsApps stub — commands ran with python (3.11.11), matching prior v3 chapter gates.

The engine subprocess e2e tests exercise mp spawn (win32) with ipc→tcp loopback fallback, the documented host seam for vLLM's Linux-only ipc:// transport; socket types (ROUTER/DEALER/PUSH/PULL), envelope framing, and handshake order are the pin's.

No temp files created by either gate pass; chapter tree contains only implementation/, tests/, dossier/, research/ plus self-ignored pytest caches (__pycache__/, .pytest_cache/ — both matched by repo .gitignore lines 10/18, confirmed via git check-ignore).

Suite is deterministic across runs (four consecutive full passes on this host); the only timing-sensitive assertions use generous windows (400ms parking checks vs 5ms seam forward, 10-30s e2e timeouts).
